about: cesr.parse cases for indexed signatures in a controller indexed signature group (-K). Each code reports exactly the index fields its row of the Annex indexed code table defines: a code with an ondex length of 0 reports index only; a code with a nonzero ondex length reports the ondex as encoded, including the current-only codes.

cases.title: Parse an Ed25519 indexed signature with one index field
cases.description: Code A# (Ed25519 indexed signature, both same): a one-character index and no ondex field, 88 characters.

cases.title: Parse current-only Ed25519 and secp256k1 indexed signatures
cases.description: Codes B# (Ed25519, current only) with index 5 and D# (ECDSA secp256k1, current only) with index 7. Both rows define an index of one character and no ondex field, so no ondex is reported.

cases.title: Parse an Ed448 dual-indexed signature
cases.description: Code 0A## (Ed448 indexed signature, dual): a one-character index (3) and a one-character ondex (4), a 114-byte signature, 156 characters.

cases.title: Parse a big dual-indexed Ed25519 signature
cases.description: Code 2A#### (Ed25519 indexed sig big dual): two-character index 65 and two-character ondex 70, 92 characters. Both values exceed what one Base64 digit holds.

cases.title: Parse a big current-only Ed25519 signature whose ondex field is zero
cases.description: Code 2B#### (Ed25519 indexed sig big current only). Its table row defines an ondex field of two characters even though the signature is current only, so the ondex is reported as encoded: 0.

cases.title: Parse a big current-only Ed25519 signature whose ondex field is not zero
cases.description: Code 2B#### with index 70 and ondex 9. The table row defines a two-character ondex field for this current-only code and states no constraint on its value, so the decoded structure reports the ondex as encoded.

dispute.summary: The Annex indexed code table gives 2B#### (Ed25519 indexed sig big current only) an ondex field of two characters and states no constraint on its value, so a stream carrying ondex 9 decodes to index 70, ondex 9. keripy main (9a8b7aa7) rejects it: Indexer raises 'Invalid ondex=9 for code=2B' because keripy requires the ondex of every current-only code to be zero (src/keri/core/indexing.py, the IdxCrtSigDex checks in _exfil and _bexfil). The specification should either state that constraint, making this a must-reject stream, or confirm that the field is free.
dispute.raised_at: generators/DISAGREEMENTS.md in this repository, 2026-10-01; not yet raised with the CESR specification working group.

cases.title: Parse a big dual-indexed Ed448 signature
cases.description: Code 3A###### (Ed448 indexed signature big dual): three-character index 4096 and ondex 5000, 160 characters.

cases.title: Parse two Ed25519 indexed signatures in the binary domain
cases.description: A -K group of two A# signatures, indexes 1 and 2, entirely in the binary domain: 44 triplets, 132 bytes of signatures.
